definitions.explanation: A shop that specializes in selling fresh fish and seafood.

examples.japanese: {鮮魚店|せんぎょてん}で{刺身|さしみ}を{買|か}う。
examples.english: To buy sashimi at a fresh fish shop.

examples.japanese: {商店街|しょうてんがい}の{鮮魚店|せんぎょてん}は{朝|あさ}が{早|はや}い。
examples.english: The fish shop in the shopping street opens early in the morning.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}の{鮮魚店|せんぎょてん}には{毎朝|まいあさ}{新鮮|しんせん}な{魚|さかな}が{並|なら}ぶ。
examples.english: Fresh fish is displayed every morning at the local fish shop.

notes:
{鮮魚|せんぎょ} (fresh fish) + {店|てん} (shop). A traditional shop type found in shopping streets and markets throughout Japan. While supermarkets have largely replaced them for everyday shopping, {鮮魚店|せんぎょてん} remain popular at markets and in areas near fishing ports for their superior quality and expert knowledge.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鮮魚店|せんぎょてん}で{買|か}う — buy at a fish shop
- {老舗|しにせ}の{鮮魚店|せんぎょてん} — long-established fish shop
- {鮮魚店|せんぎょてん}の{店主|てんしゅ} — fish shop owner

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {魚屋|さかなや} — fish shop; fishmonger — the everyday, colloquial term
- {鮮魚|せんぎょ} — fresh fish — the product itself
- {魚市場|うおいちば} — fish market — a larger wholesale or retail market for fish
